propositions: Jira-specific literal lazy-load keys ('rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira.adf' and 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira.comment_limits') are hardcoded into backend-neutral core modules (outbound_comments.py, inbound_translate.py), causing vendor code to execute for non-Jira backends.
Comment body formatting, truncation, and ADF-to-text normalization must be routed through backend-agnostic port roles (FieldSanitizer and InboundMapper) instead of direct lazy-loaded vendor modules.
FieldSanitizer requires a new pure fit-to-limit method (fit_comment) for comment-diff comparison that truncates without send-side warnings, separate from the existing sanitize_comment defense.

InboundMapper requires a new normalize_rich_text method that decodes vendor rich-text (ADF for Jira, identity for plain text) and serves both inbound apply path and outbound comment-diff decode, replacing _ADF_KEY_APPLIER and _normalize_adf_body internals.

The public function _normalize_adf_body in inbound_translate.py must remain re-exported and callable but internally route through the selected backend's InboundMapper, with vendor-specific loader internals (_ADF_KEY_APPLIER, _AdfModule_Applier, _load_adf_module) deleted.

A linting gate must prevent core modules from containing 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira' literals, with a documented exemption for inbound_fields.py (the Jira InboundMapper implementation) tracked by follow-up ticket 556a-5a1f-adb3-4139.
